section.name: tenant
section.title: TENANT CONFIGURATION
section.preamble: Each [tenant.<label>] section defines one provider served by the daemon. Use type = entra for Microsoft Entra ID or type = oidc for OpenID Connect. Okta backend selection is automatic within each OIDC provider. .P Set domain to the provider's primary domain and domain_aliases to its other sign-in domains. The domain keys device credentials, the server cache and ID mapping. Preserve that value and idmap_range when converting an existing configuration. Legacy OIDC configurations use domain = oidc as their storage key; list their scoped account suffixes in domain_aliases when converting them. .P With several providers, mark exactly one default = true and assign each a non-overlapping idmap_range. A single provider is the implicit default. Bare account names and cn_name_mapping use the default provider. OIDC account-name claims on other providers must contain a configured domain or alias. oidc_account_id_strip_at_suffix is supported on the default provider. .P Provider settings override [global] settings. Discovered metadata is stored separately in /var/cache/himmelblaud/himmelblau.conf. Only administrator configuration defines providers. Unknown Entra aliases are accepted after their tenant ID is matched to a configured provider. .P Initialization and connectivity checks run independently for each provider. Initialization failures are logged and skipped; startup fails if none initialize. aad-tool status reports connectivity per provider. aad-tool --domain DOMAIN selects a provider for tenant-scoped commands; credential commands also accept --domain after the subcommand. The default provider is used when no account or domain is supplied. .P pam_allow_groups and sudo_groups are evaluated for the selected provider. Entra group rules use object IDs. OIDC pam_allow_groups also accepts group claims. Duplicate group display names retain separate UUIDs and memberships; ambiguous name lookups fail. Keep home directories distinct: CN home naming requires a separate home_prefix for each tenant sharing that naming scheme. Each home_prefix directory must already exist. .P When apply_policy is enabled, each Entra tenant enrolls and applies its Intune policy. Device-wide settings are shared: the last applied policy wins on conflicts. .P The daemon validates configuration at startup and with --configtest. It rejects mixed legacy/stanza definitions, duplicate domains, aliases or tenant identities, overlapping ID ranges, and multi-provider rfc2307 mappings.
section.subsection_intro: One section per provider; labels are local configuration handles.
section.example:
[tenant.contoso] domain = contoso.com domain_aliases = contoso.org default = true idmap_range = 200000-999999 home_prefix = /home/contoso/
[tenant.fabrikam] domain = fabrikam.com idmap_range = 1000000-1999999 home_prefix = /home/fabrikam/

[tenant.contoso] domain = contoso.com default = true idmap_range = 200000-999999 home_prefix = /home/contoso/
[tenant.partners] type = oidc domain = partners.example oidc_issuer_url = https://id.partners.example/realms/linux app_id = linux-login idmap_range = 1000000-1999999 home_prefix = /home/partners/ pam_allow_groups = linux-users
